test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 24 Jun, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: If the length of a cuboid is 4 cm, breadth is 46 cm and volume is 8832 cm³, then find the height (in cm) of the cuboid.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**Volume** of cuboid = **Length** × **Breadth** × **Height**

8832 = 4 × 46 × **Height**

8832 = 184 × **Height**

**Height** = 8832 ÷ 184 = 48 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 48 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Length** (l) = 4 cm

**Breadth** (b) = 46 cm

**Volume** (V) = 8832 cm³

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/82f0b2b1cef0f6c427fbadba0199378c3d25c1f8007b2ea5ccbe1c9450c0d62a.png] 

**Formula Used:**

**Volume** of a **Cuboid** = **Length** × **Breadth** × **Height**

**Calculations:**

⇒ 8832 = 4 × 46 × **h**

⇒ 8832 = 184 × **h**

⇒ **h** = 8832 ÷ 184

⇒ **h** = 48 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 48 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Total Surface Area of Cuboid

The total area of all faces is given by 2 × (lb + bh + hl).

Diagonal of a Cuboid

The length of the longest rod that can be placed inside is √(l² + b² + h²).

Lateral Surface Area

The area of the four side walls is given by 2 × **Height** × (**Length** + **Breadth**).</p
